description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductOptionService interface in a retail or e-commerce system, managing product options through various CRUD operations, including listing, searching by name or code, saving, updating, and deleting options. It interacts with the data access layer and other services to perform its functions.

classes.name: ProductOptionServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing business logic for managing product options within an e-commerce system, including CRUD operations and integrations with data access and attribute management services.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product options available in a specific store and language.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a read-only list of product options for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches product options matching a specific name within a store and language, throws ServiceException if an error occurs.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product option and its associated product attributes from the store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option by its unique code within a store.
